# create-fself (ported)

`src/orbislink/fpkg/fself.{h,cpp}` is a C++ port of the fake-signed SELF
writer of [create-fself](https://github.com/OpenOrbis/create-fself) by the
OpenOrbis team, itself a port of flatz' `make_fself.py`. It is licensed under
the GNU GPL version 3 (see `LICENSE`); the ported files keep that licence.
